title: Insights middleware sometimes fails to initialize insightsClient before the first event.

comments.body:
> However what if they somehow initialize it? It's actually okay. It will re-assign some variables. No problem.

I thought an error was thrown on double init?
we can also check for `init` in the queue, like we do for userToken, and we could skip in that case? I'm in favour of making this sync instead of async though!

I know this is an old issue but it seems like the 'init' event call is still `void` so we don't really know if it's been initialised yet.

Has anyone found a workaround for this, aside from above? How come we don't have access to know if it's been initialised (or have I missed some documentation)?

I believe now the behaviour is calling `init` in most cases, can you clarify exactly in which situation you are that you want to check if insights is already `init`ed? We definitely have changed the behaviour of search-insights to allow multiple `init` calls without resetting defaults
